definition_used: Duplication of a published item, or undefined sections of it.
caution: Duplication may overlap with plagiarism or self-plagiarism, but the definition is broad and does not specify intent or fault. Actor context is unclear as the definition does not indicate who identified or investigated the duplication.
semantic_rationale: Duplication of a published item or sections directly impacts the reliability of research content and raises questions about attribution and disclosure integrity, as it may involve reuse without proper citation or permission.
